title: Formspec Locale Document (v2.0)
description: A Formspec Locale Document provides internationalized strings for one exact Definition or App Manifest target. Locale 2.0 replaces targetDefinition with target.kind plus target.url, admits the closed Surface shell key family, uses FEL {{expression}} interpolation as its only authored template syntax, and keeps every fallback step within the same target identity. A Locale Document MUST NOT affect data collection, validation logic, authorization, or behavioral semantics.

x-lm.intent: Version pin for locale document compatibility. Processors MUST reject locale documents with an unrecognized version.

modules.description: OPTIONAL declaration of substrate modules this document depends on. Each entry is a canonical ModuleRef. Module-contributed Locale string keys use $module.<modId>.<nodeId>.<prop>. The x-formspec-surface module reserves the closed $module.x-formspec-surface.shell.<SurfaceStringKey> family for app-targeted shell text.

url.description: Canonical identifier for this Locale Document. Stable across versions — the tuple (url, version) SHOULD be globally unique.

version.description: Version of this Locale Document. SemVer is RECOMMENDED. The tuple (url, version) SHOULD be unique across all published locale versions.

x-lm.intent: Locale document revision identifier. Enables cache-busting and auditing which locale version was applied.

name.description: Machine-friendly short identifier for programmatic use.

title.description: Human-readable display name for the Locale Document.

description.description: Human-readable description of the locale's purpose and target audience.
examples: French-Canadian localization for the annual budget form.
Latin American Spanish translations for the patient intake questionnaire.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag identifying the locale this document provides strings for. Processors MUST perform case-insensitive comparison and SHOULD normalize to lowercase language with title-case region (e.g., 'fr-CA').

x-lm.intent: Identifies the language/region this locale covers. Used as the lookup key when setLocale() is called and as the cascade entry point.

fallback.description: BCP 47 language tag of the locale to consult when a key is not found in this document's strings. Enables explicit fallback chains (e.g., fr-CA → fr). If absent, the cascade proceeds to implicit language fallback (strip region subtag) or inline defaults. Processors MUST detect circular fallback chains and terminate the cascade with a warning.

formats.description: How this locale writes values that FEL formats by style. formats.date maps a formatDate style name (short, medium, long, full) to a pattern; a style without a pattern keeps the processor's built-in rendering for the locale. Patterns use the ICU letters yyyy, yy, MMMM, MMM, MM, M, dd, d, EEEE, EEE; every other character is literal. A Definition never carries a pattern: it names the style, the Locale decides the shape.

target.description: Exact Definition or App Manifest target. Loaded Locale identity is (target.kind, target.url, normalized locale). A processor MUST NOT apply this document to another target or cross target identity during fallback.

x-lm.intent: Declares the exact Definition or app this Locale can be applied to and bounds fallback to that target.

propertyNames.description: String keys are dot-delimited. Item strings use <itemKey>.<property>, where <itemKey> is the bare Item key at any depth (amount.label for lineItems[*].amount); dotted template paths such as lineItems.amount.label are not valid item keys. The $module.x-formspec-surface.shell.<SurfaceStringKey> family is closed to the exact SurfaceShellStringKey enum. The $ui.<ChromeStringKey> family (target.kind: definition) is closed to the exact ChromeStringKey enum — renderer chrome strings, {{$param}} filled literally, never FEL. Other module keys retain $module.<modId>.<nodeId>.<prop> addressing.

strings.description: Map of string keys to localized values. Values are strings and MAY contain FEL interpolation only through {{expression}} syntax. Surface-only {name} placeholders are not a second template language. Shell keys use the read-only shell variable context defined by the Locale specification.

x-lm.intent: The core payload of a Locale Document. Each entry overrides one localizable string for the exact target. Values support FEL interpolation for dynamic content.

stringGeneration.description: Generation provenance keyed exactly like strings. Strict data-only authoring profiles require every authored localized string to have a same-key direct current adopted Need anchor.

extensions.description: Extension namespace for vendor-specific or tooling-specific metadata. All keys MUST be x- prefixed. Processors MUST ignore unrecognized extensions. Extensions MUST NOT alter locale resolution semantics.

kind.description: Target artifact kind. No aliases or additional kinds are admitted in Locale 2.0.

url.description: Canonical absolute URL of the target Definition or App Manifest.

compatibleVersions.description: Optional SemVer range checked against the selected target's version.

SurfaceShellStringKey.description: Closed one-to-one mapping to SurfaceStringKey. A new shell string requires a Locale schema revision.

ChromeStringKey.description: Closed one-to-one mapping to the renderer chrome string inventory (Locale spec §3.1.10, packages/formspec-layout/src/ui-strings.ts). A new chrome string requires a Locale schema revision.
